0022600098.text: The Heat (0-1, 5th in the Southeast and 14th in the East) host the Pistons (1-0, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East), with Miami looking for its first win of 2026-27 after dropping its opener. Detroit has won its only game so far this season. Miami won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 121-110 home win over Detroit on March 8, 2026, and the teams have not yet met this season.
